description: This file contains unit tests for the BuzzLikeDao class within the OrangeHRM system, specifically testing the CRUD operations and retrieval methods for BuzzLikeOnShare and BuzzLikeOnComment entities related to the Buzz module's data access layer.

classes.name: BuzzLikeDaoTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the BuzzLikeDao, testing operations related to entities BuzzLikeOnShare and BuzzLikeOnComment, including saving, deleting, and retrieving like records.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, including instantiating the BuzzLikeDao, mocking DateTimeHelperService, and populating test data.

methods.name: testSaveBuzzLikeOnShare
methods.description: Tests saving a BuzzLikeOnShare entity and verifies attributes like employee name, share ID, liked date and time.

methods.name: testSaveBuzzLikeOnComment
methods.description: Tests saving a BuzzLikeOnComment entity and verifies attributes like employee name, comment ID, liked date and time.

methods.name: testDeleteBuzzLikeOnShare
methods.description: Tests deletion of BuzzLikeOnShare records based on share and employee IDs, and verifies removal.

methods.name: testDeleteBuzzLikeOnComment
methods.description: Tests deletion of BuzzLikeOnComment records based on comment and employee IDs, and verifies removal.

methods.name: testGetBuzzLikeOnShareByShareIdAndEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves a BuzzLikeOnShare entity by share ID and employee number, verifies correct entity is fetched.

methods.name: testGetBuzzLikeOnCommentByShareIdAndEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves a BuzzLikeOnComment entity by comment ID and employee number, verifies correctness.

methods.name: testGetBuzzLikeOnShareList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of BuzzLikeOnShare entries filtered by share ID, verifies correct list and contents.

methods.name: testGetBuzzLikeOnShareCount
methods.description: Tests counting of BuzzLikeOnShare entries for specific share IDs, verifies counts.

methods.name: testGetBuzzLikeOnCommentList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of BuzzLikeOnComment entries filtered by comment ID, verifies entries.

methods.name: testGetBuzzLikeOnCommentCount
methods.description: Tests counting BuzzLikeOnComment entries for given comment IDs, verifies counts.
